def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_set = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for node in route:
            s += demands[node]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for a, b in zip(route, route[1:]):
            c += matrix[a][b]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    # Initial incumbent construction (EDIT 1): Clarke-Wright savings with deterministic merges

    loads = []

        routes.append([node])
        loads.append(demands[node])

    n_cust = len(customers_set)
    if n_cust == 0:
        return []

    # Compute savings for all ordered pairs i<j, deterministic sorting by (saving desc, i asc, j asc)
    savings = []
    cust_list = sorted(customers_set)
    for a_i in range(n_cust):
        i = cust_list[a_i]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for a_j in range(a_i + 1, n_cust):
            j = cust_list[a_j]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            # store positive/negative; still sorted desc
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2]))

    def try_merge(i, j):
        ri = node_to_route.get(i, None)
        rj = node_to_route.get(j, None)
        if ri is None or rj is None or ri == rj:
            return False
        if loads[ri] + loads[rj] > capacity:
            return False

        route_i = routes[ri]
        route_j = routes[rj]
        if not route_i or not route_j:
            return False

        i_at_start = (route_i[0] == i)
        i_at_end = (route_i[-1] == i)
        j_at_start = (route_j[0] == j)
        j_at_end = (route_j[-1] == j)

        # Determine feasible merge pattern and orientation with reversals
        # Pattern A: i at end of route_i and j at start of route_j -> route_i + route_j
        if i_at_end and j_at_start:
            merged = route_i + route_j
        # Pattern B: i at start of route_i and j at end of route_j -> route_j + route_i
        elif i_at_start and j_at_end:
            merged = route_j + route_i
        # Pattern C: i at start and j at start -> reverse i-route, then route_i_rev + route_j
        elif i_at_start and j_at_start:
            merged = route_i[::-1] + route_j
        # Pattern D: i at end and j at end -> reverse j-route, then route_i + route_j_rev
        elif i_at_end and j_at_end:
            merged = route_i + route_j[::-1]
        else:
            return False

        # Apply merge: replace ri with merged, clear rj
        routes[ri] = merged
        loads[ri] = loads[ri] + loads[rj]
        routes[rj] = []
        loads[rj] = 0

        for node in merged:
            node_to_route[node] = ri
        return True

    for s, i, j in savings:
        try_merge(i, j)

    # Collect non-empty routes
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

    # Local search: targeted, interpretable mutations (small, safe edits)
    # Phase 1: inter-route relocate (1-0 move) with best insertion position
    # Build loads from routes for safety (EDIT 2: rebind after possible changes)

                nxt = depot

                nxt = route[pos]
                delta = (matrix[prev][node] + matrix[node][nxt]) - matrix[prev][nxt]

                best_pos = pos

        route.insert(pos, node)

                    if loads[j] + demands[node] > capacity:

                    pos, delta_insert_j = best_insertion_cost(routes[j], node)
                    delta_total = delta_remove_i + delta_insert_j
                    if best is None or delta_total < best[0] - 1e-12:

                    loads[i] = new_load_i
                    apply_insertion(routes[j], pos, node)

                        del rj2[kj]
